title: Ham Radio Contest — Active Solar Region
description: A major international DX contest is underway. Kp is currently 2, but an active solar region just produced an M5 flare and a fast CME is Earth-directed. The 20m band is still open. Do you continue operating or pause?
historicalOutcome: Operators who continued experienced brief fadeouts but made many contacts during the disturbed conditions. Those who paused missed peak propagation windows.
